away.summary: The Flyers (3-7-4) are playing the second game of a back-to-back and their third game in four nights, having lost 4-3 in overtime to Columbus on Tuesday. They remain winless against Metropolitan Division opponents this season. Trevor Zegras leads the team in points and is a key focus after a strong comeback performance Tuesday.

home.summary: The Capitals (6-4-0) are well-rested after three days off following a 4-3 overtime win over Buffalo on Saturday. Logan Thompson was activated from injured reserve after missing the Sabres game with a lower-body injury, and Mitchell Gibson was returned to Hershey. Jack St. Ivany will make his Capitals debut after being claimed off waivers from Winnipeg.
